Various newspapers endorsed candidates in the 2016 United States presidential election, as follows.
Tables below also show which candidate each publication endorsed in the 2012 United States presidential election (where known) and include only endorsements for the general election.
Primary endorsements are separately listed - see Newspaper endorsements in the United States presidential primaries, 2016.
This list includes newspapers that publish three or fewer times per week.
